audit_name: Paired Two-Way Crossed Cluster Bootstrap Analysis

methodology.bootstrap_framework: Cameron, Gelbach, & Miller (2011) multi-way clustered resampling for crossed grouping factors
methodology.paired_difference_formula: Delta_Acc_b = sum(w_i * [I(pred_cont_i == y_i) - I(pred_raw_i == y_i)]) / sum(w_i)
methodology.multiplier_weights: w_i = c_counts[cand(i)] * j_counts[job(i)] where counts ~ Multinomial(K, 1/K)

aggregate_bootstrap_summary.scientific_limitation_statement: Under two-way crossed candidate and job clustering, the effective sample size is deflated (N_eff ~ 160). Consequently, the sampling standard error of the paired difference is inflated to ~5.2 - 5.9 percentage points. While all five point estimates are positive and four of five indicate substantial gains (+7.4% to +8.1%), the two-way cluster bootstrap 95% confidence intervals cross zero across all seeds. A larger evaluation sample (e.g. the planned 2,850 pairs) is required to establish two-way cluster-adjusted statistical significance.
